beats.picture: The camp on the night before; the Thread; Edric rises
Cross-cut: our army against the Empire
The seers; officers and the Emperor
Chorus: the charge, the fraying thread, the falls
Edric looks up; silence; the Hollow Sun and title
Model sheets (for the rig, not a beat)
Endings and defeat (end_normal, end_hard, thread_cut, end_true)

rows.subject: Edric's eye; a banner reflected in the iris
rows.why: Survives conversion.

rows.subject: Gloved hand closing on a plain longsword hilt; teal cloak
rows.why: The teal cloak and belt make it Edric's. Code adds the thread at the wrist.

rows.subject: Six iron-shod boots stamping in step on bare paper
rows.why: Dense and flat, as the Empire is drawn. Survives conversion.

rows.subject: Imperial pikeman marching in profile, facing left
rows.why: Tiles into lockstep ranks (tested on the road plate).
rows.layers: cloak, pike arm, near leg, far leg, body

rows.subject: The Hollow Sun setting over a dark valley
rows.why: Dark and dense. The camp plate opens the story, and code draws the sun.

rows.subject: Four diagonal panels: Sera, crimson, a violet city, a yellow sun
rows.why: Made for the vocal version. The last panel shows a bright yellow sun, not the Hollow Sun. The diagonal-panel layout is a good idea for the bar 1-4 flashes, done in code.

rows.subject: Night camp, empty; fire low; a clear sky band for the Thread
rows.why: Right layout: no people, fire low, an empty sky band, tall for the tilt. Detailed, so convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Edric seated, sword drawn across his knees, looking to the side
rows.why: Keys cleanly. Hair drifts auburn (the portrait is chestnut).
rows.layers: head and hair, cloak, arms with sword, body

rows.subject: Edric looks up at the night sky; firelight below
rows.why: Use for Edric seeing the Thread in bars 5-12. Not the final frame: b53_edric_final_frame replaces it there.

rows.subject: Kira on a crate, reading a map across the knees
rows.why: On-model; the face leans androgynous as asked.
rows.layers: head, map and hands, coat, crate

rows.subject: Sera seated, knees up, blanket round her shoulders, looking up
rows.why: On-model; the gold cross is there.
rows.layers: hair, blanket, body

rows.subject: Edric standing, three-quarter view, looking up past the viewer; gold thread at his wrist
rows.why: Clean key, on-model; the model for all character assets. "Edric rises", and the standing Edric in the ensemble.
rows.layers: hair, head, cloak, sword arm, body, legs

rows.subject: Edric reaches back for Sera's hand in ruins
rows.why: Replaced by sketchbook 04-bridge-thread: the same hands-joined beat, in style.

rows.subject: Astrid mounted on a white winged horse, facing right
rows.why: On-model. Mounted cards need about 1.45x scale to match the figures on foot.
rows.layers: near wing, far wing, rider with lance, horse, tail

rows.subject: Cael in plate with an open helm, axe across his body
rows.why: On-model.
rows.layers: scarf and cloak, arms with axe, body

rows.subject: Kira pointing right, tome in hand
rows.why: On-model. Fix before use: paint out a small pale-blue glint behind the head.
rows.layers: hair, pointing arm, coat tails, body

rows.subject: Rowan mounted on a bay horse, lance upright
rows.why: On-model. About 1.45x scale to match the figures on foot.
rows.layers: rider with lance, scarf, horse, tail

rows.subject: Sera standing, one hand raised, feeling for the thread
rows.why: Gold cross present; on-model.
rows.layers: hair, head, raised arm and sleeve, robe

rows.subject: Voss with bow, quiver and green cloak
rows.why: On-model: scar, beard, tied-back hair.
rows.layers: cloak, bow arm, body

rows.subject: Straight road side-on under a crimson sky
rows.why: For the marching column. Match the left and right edges before tiling.

rows.subject: Bareheaded drill officer, sword raised, calling the count
rows.why: Dense and flat, faces left. A scar already gives him his own face.
rows.layers: sword arm, head, cloak, body

rows.subject: Mounted officer on a black horse, walking left
rows.why: Profile, one foreleg raised: a walk cycle can start from this pose.
rows.layers: rider, cloak, caparison, horse, tail

rows.subject: Standard-bearer marching left; black sword on crimson
rows.why: Profile march, matches the soldier. The banner can hang on a spring in code.
rows.layers: banner, pole arm, cloak, legs, body

rows.subject: Edric and Sera hand in hand, crossing a ruined bridge along the thread
rows.why: Wide establishing shot. The figures are about 80 px tall at game size, so no acting at this scale. Crop the torn border.

rows.subject: Imperial spearman standing front-on at rest
rows.why: Livery is right (crimson, cross clasps), but he stands front-on at rest. Usable as-is for ranks facing the camera; b13_empire_soldier_march covers the march.

rows.subject: Kira points with a map, Astrid overhead, Edric braces on a bridge in iron rain
rows.why: Replaced by the batch-2 cast cards. The figures are part of a busy scene, so they cannot be layered.

rows.subject: Torn crimson banner over a city under the black sun; travellers below
rows.why: Dense. The soldier, boots and road assets carry the Empire now.

rows.subject: Cleaner redraw of 05-bridge-ensemble
rows.why: Replaced by the cast cards; cannot be layered.

rows.subject: The Emperor standing with a sceptre
rows.why: Close to the portrait. Stands with a sceptre, not on a throne; more flexible.
rows.layers: crown and head, cloak, sceptre arm, body

rows.subject: The Lieutenant's eyes; white streak, cracks and a red eye
rows.why: On-model: the cracks and the red eye are on the same side as in the portrait.

rows.subject: Sera's eyes; a gold crack in one iris
rows.why: Green eyes, as in the portrait. Same eye height as the Lieutenant's, for the mirrored cut.

rows.subject: The Lieutenant standing, hand raised, mirroring a seer
rows.why: Faces left. Mirrors Sera reaching for the thread.
rows.layers: raised arm, head, cloak, body

rows.subject: The Lieutenant, gold threads whole in one hand, crimson snapped in the other
rows.why: Replaces the old reveal. Cracks and red eye on the correct side. Delivered 1672x941 and centre-cropped to 3:2 by the generator.

rows.subject: Sera winds a gold thread round two fingers
rows.why: Replaces the old close-up. Delivered 1672x941 and centre-cropped to 3:2.

rows.subject: Sera close-up, repainted with the new face
rows.why: Nearly identical to the batch-3 version; either works.

rows.subject: Sera at a ruined window finds the thread
rows.why: On-model, and survives conversion well. The robe has no gold cross (minor). Crop the torn border.

rows.subject: Sera winds a gold thread round her fingers; dawn in her eye
rows.why: Replaced by batch-3 b21_sera_closeup.

rows.subject: The Lieutenant, symmetrical, holding gold and snapped crimson threads
rows.why: Replaced by batch-3 b21_lieutenant_threads.

rows.subject: Sera at a rain-streaked window; her reflection shows a future city
rows.why: Replaced by sketchbook 03-sera-window.

rows.subject: Edric running right, sword low, cloak streaming
rows.why: Runs right (our side's direction). Clean, held pose.
rows.layers: hair, cloak, sword arm, far arm, body, legs

rows.subject: Edric stumbling as he is hit
rows.why: The fall on each hit. Hair drifts auburn.
rows.layers: hair, cloak, sword arm, body

rows.subject: Shallow ford at dusk; torn blue banner; no people
rows.why: First fall. Convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Stone bridge over a misty gorge; torn blue banner
rows.why: Second fall. The orange sunset and visible sun break the one-warm-light rule: take the sun out and cool the grade in code (tested). Convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Edric on one knee, sword planted, head bowed
rows.why: The held collapse for the freeze and crack. Rips in the cloak key through as holes, which reads as torn cloth.
rows.layers: hair and head, cloak, body with arms and sword

rows.subject: Grey fens; broken spears; ruins in the fog
rows.why: Third fall. Same sunset fix as the bridge (tested). Convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Grassy ridge under a clear violet dusk sky
rows.why: The sky is clear for the code-drawn Hollow Sun. Tested with the charge and with the whole cast.

rows.subject: Wide stair to a fortress gate; crimson banners
rows.why: Fourth fall. Convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Cold first light over a misty valley; an open hilltop
rows.why: No sun. Wide enough for the whole cast. Convert with the background settings.

rows.subject: Sera's hands on the thread: whole, fraying, half unravelled
rows.why: The three frames are registered, so they play in sequence. Frame 1 doubles for the hymn.

rows.subject: Sera running right, skirts gathered, hand reaching forward
rows.why: Pairs with b29_edric_charge. Matches the cast card costume.
rows.layers: hair, reaching arm and sleeve, skirt-hand arm, robe, legs

rows.subject: Allied militia spearman, kettle helm, teal armband, facing right
rows.why: For filling out the army at first light; repeat and vary in code.
rows.layers: spear arm, pack, body

rows.subject: Allied militia, nasal helm, mail, round shield, facing right
rows.why: Background ranks only: no longer reads as Voss, but rendered more realistically than the cast (owner). Regenerate both allies with anime faces if they ever come forward.
rows.layers: shield arm, body

rows.subject: Sera and Edric run under the black sun
rows.why: Failed the pixel test: the dense texture turns to mush at 480×270. 11-chorus-run-clean is the cleaner version.

rows.subject: Sera and Edric run together, black sun behind
rows.why: Replaced by batch-3 b29_sera_run with b29_edric_charge on the ridge plate.

rows.subject: Sera's hands pull a gold thread taut as it frays
rows.why: Replaced by batch-3 b29_sera_hands_fray_strip.

rows.subject: Edric kneels; his earlier falls ghosted behind him
rows.why: Replaced by the falls on four plates (batches 1 and 2). The ghosted-repeat idea is done in code.

rows.subject: Sera and Edric on a hill above a valley at dawn
rows.why: Replaced by batch-3 b29_first_light_plate with the cast cards. It also shows a bright sun.

rows.subject: Allied militia, mail shirt and round shield, facing right
rows.why: Reads as Voss (long brown hair tied back, stubble). Owner: rework. Replacement prompt in prompts-batch-6.md.

rows.subject: Gold thread stitched across paper, fraying beside an ink eclipse
rows.why: Already the Unwritten Page idea: bare paper, a stitched thread, an ink eclipse. Sparse, so it survives conversion. Code redraws the thread so it can animate.

rows.subject: Sera kneeling, eyes closed, drawing the thread back
rows.why: Side view facing right; hair and sleeves ready for a wind spring in code.
rows.layers: hair, sleeves and hands, robe

rows.subject: Empty page: a half-erased battlefield, a sewn thread ending at the centre
rows.why: The hymn. Convert with the background settings. Crop the torn paper border, and cover the painted thread so code can draw it.

rows.subject: A ghosted crowd walks backward over wet stone (the Roll)
rows.why: In "Again" the rewind uses the opening's own frames, stripped back to paper in code. Keep only as a concept note.

rows.subject: Line-only redraw of the camp plate (rewind test)
rows.why: Shapes move and new things appear (stars, a palisade). Cannot cross-fade with the painting; code fakes the paint stages.

rows.subject: Line-only redraw of the final frame (rewind test)
rows.why: Face, hair and cloth move. Keep only as a reference for the line style.

rows.subject: One gold thread hanging over a faint ring on black
rows.why: Sparse, and it survives conversion. Composition reference for the silence at the end; code draws the thread and the ring.

rows.subject: Edric at the fire looks straight into the camera; full colour
rows.why: The final frame, and the only fully painted one. Chestnut hair; the ghost of a smile.

rows.subject: Final frame, repainted with the new Edric face
rows.why: Firmer face that matches ms2_edric_heads. The batch-2 version stays as the alternate: owner picks.

rows.subject: Cleaner redraw of 03-hollow-sun-cut
rows.why: The old ending. Code draws the final Hollow Sun and the title.

rows.why: Turnaround: front, three-quarter, side, back.

rows.subject: Kira: six heads, androgynous face, facing right

rows.subject: Rowan: six heads, broad face, no tooth gap, facing right
rows.why: Registered for swaps: silhouettes overlap 97% between heads (batch 3: 98%). Blink tested: the closed eyes patch cleanly onto the open head. The closed eyes are a smiling squint, which suits his grin.

rows.subject: Sera: six heads, distinct face, facing right
